resources.string: Shows when PhoneCast is capturing the screen
Enter the receiver address and pairing code, then approve screen capture to stream H.264 over your local network.

Optional notification forwarding sends brief cards only while casting. It is off by default. Message titles and text stay hidden unless you explicitly enable content. Package allow/block lists accept comma-separated Android package names. The current trusted-LAN connection is not encrypted.
Forward notifications to VR while casting
Include notification titles and message text (sensitive)
Injects only the taps, swipes, scrolls, and Back actions you request from your paired PhoneCast VR receiver. It does not read app text or inspect window content.

Optional remote control uses Android Accessibility to inject taps, swipes, scrolls, and Back requested from the connected VR receiver. PhoneCast does not inspect app text or window content. Commands and video use the current unencrypted trusted-LAN connection.
Start PhoneCast with the saved receiver and pairing code
